collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 1993 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 1993 to 1996 (W124) model requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this E Class, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
